evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative command directed at an audience, enacting hierarchy through a directive to discard knowledge.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Second imperative command expanding the scope of what must be purged, reinforcing rank-based authority over the record.
Assertive declaration that rewrites the institutional record by authority, foreclosing what the observatory did.
